profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Computer Science graduate with a strong educational background and experience in the field of software development and database management, striving to continuously learn and grow with the organization. Pursuing new opportunities to implement my analytical and problem solving skills acquired through hands-on work experience, academic coursework and projects.

Technical Skills:
Web Development: AngularJS, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, ASP.NET, API
Database: RDBMS, SQL, MongoDB, NoSQL, JSON, MySQL
Software Testing: JaCoCo, JUnit
Language: Java
Software: SAP, Microsoft Office, My SQL Workbench, Eclipse, Visual Studio

company.name: The University of Texas at Arlington

positions.title: Graduate Student
positions.description:
WEB DEVELOPMENT:

o  Created web application that fetches data from JSON file and displays on HTML page using HTML, CSS, AngularJS, NodeJS and AJAX style API call through MVC Structure that shows the state location in Google Map by clicking on its name. Also, deployed web application on Heroku
o Designed web application that fetched data from MONGOLAB (online) and maintained a display of twenty records by removing one old record on addition of new record at one second interval using AJAX style API call, HTML, CSS, and AngularJS. Also, deployed it on Heroku
o  Designed a website for online money transfer in ASP.NET that stored, fetched, updated and deleted data in Relational Database (SQL)
o  Accomplished a project on Software Project Management (SPM) system using ASP.NET and Relational Database (SQL)

DATABASE SYSTEMS MANAGEMENT:

o  Implemented a Java program to extract and store the data from 6 CSV files to 2 JSON files and loaded those JSON files into MongoDB (NoSQL Database)
o  Performed queries on them to retrieve some of the stored data based on given requirement using Command Line
o  Implemented a Java program to perform 2PL (two phase locking) protocol for concurrency control of data transaction
o  Developed a Java based project to find values for NULLs in Relational Database(Healthcare) using association rules (Lift, Support, and Confidence)
o  Designed a basic website for video game collection in PHP that interacts with the database created using MySQL workbench
o  Designed and created Relational Schema for given data in MySQL and performed queries on that database

positions.title: Graduate Student
positions.description:
SOFTWARE ENGINEERING:

o  Developed Work Break Down structure in Microsoft Excel and utilized it for academic projects
o  Created flowcharts, layouts, diagrams, and then calculated Cyclomatic complexity of given programs
o  Performed root cause analysis using Swim Lane Diagram and Causal Model to identify causes of delay in rectifying customers complains
o  Analyzed the report on “Mars Polar lander failure investigation” report by NASA to identify and document probable failures in software development life cycle and to provide plausible solutions

SOFTWARE TESTING:

o  Reviewed and tested the performance of Amazon Drone Delivery Vehicle simulator application software against its specific requirements. Used JaCoco to get the JUnit test cases’ coverage
o  Collaborated with team members to identify bugs during code testing and to implement adequate fixes

COMPUTER NETWORKS:

o  Developed a code for socket programming for TCP using Python to create a web server that handled one HTTP request
o  Generated codes in Python to send and receive datagram packets using UDP sockets
o  Developed a Java project for Peer-to-peer (P2P) file sharing concept	
o  Developed a network simulator that runs on single computer with basic router and link capabilities in which each router was distinct, separately configurable process

ALGORITHMS:

o  Implemented Selection sort, insertion sort and median finding algorithm in Java
o  Designed and implemented an algorithm in Java to find all bridges in an undirected graph

positions.title: SAP Intern
positions.description:
o  Designed and developed an application for power utility and integration of Gate Pass System for material management in SAP using ABAP.
o  Developed practical understanding of System Applications and Products in Data processing (SAP) and programming language ABAP
o  Developed an understanding of responsibilities in Material Management Department
